name: xlc-work-events
description: Let a Work chat subscribe to authenticated external messages and scheduled check-in signals for Xie Linchuan.

interface.displayName: 谢临川 · Work 事件桥
interface.longDescription: 订阅独立消息桥的外部消息和每 15 分钟检查信号，由当前 Work 对话决定何时联系用户。
